Grace / Ben / Maya —

Thanks — I reviewed Stellix's marked draft and prepared targeted redlines. High-level positions:

1) Net terms: Legal is fine to accommodate Net90 as an exception provided Finance requires a credit hold trigger for overdue balances and Redwood retains right to suspend service after 120 days. We will propose a temporary Net90 exception clause that auto-reverts to Net60 after 12 months unless renewed.

2) Withholding taxes: We will accept government-issued withholding certificates. Required evidence: (a) official certificate (English translation if not in English), (b) payer tax ID, and (c) a completed W-8 or local equivalent. If Stellix cannot produce the certificate within 60 days of invoice, Redwood may require gross-up for the unpaid withholding amount. We'll add a remedy path that permits invoice adjustment and a 30-day cure.

3) Activation fee: Legal will allow the split as a commercial amendment — we will redline the Order Form to show $25k on Invoice 1 and $25k on Invoice 2.

4) Min commit phasing: We propose language that phases the minimum commit for months 1–3 at 30%/35%/35% of the quarterly commitment to reflect ramp. This avoids modifying SKU-level pricing.

Attached is my redline: OrderForm_Stellix_redline_v2.docx.

I can turn this around as a tracked Word doc; if they agree to Net90 with our credit hold and documentation requirements, we should be able to finalize quickly.
